prompt: Edit this photo of a house. Replace the mowed lawn with planting beds, keeping the lawn's exact outline and edges. Use drought-tolerant native shrubs and ornamental grasses, gravel mulch between plants, a few low boulders. Only change front lawn on the right side of the driveway. Add a tidy array of dark solar panels flush-mounted on the roof plane that faces the camera. Use black-framed panels in neat rows, setbacks from the roof edges and ridge. Only change main pitched roof with dormers facing front. Add simple fabric awnings directly above the front-facing windows. Use muted neutral fabric that matches the house colors, modest projection. Only change windows on the dormers and main ground level facade. Keep the house's shape, roofline, siding, windows and doors; the driveway and walkways exactly as they are, including any cracks, stains and weeds; existing objects such as lamp posts, planters, mailboxes and utility poles; the trees, sky, lighting, shadows and season; the same camera position and framing. Keep the existing wear (fair, with minor wear and cracks on the driveway). Photorealistic; no new buildings, people, text or cars; don't tidy or renovate anything else.
